subject: Security exhibit handoff and procurement timeline for MSA/Order Form
messages:
From: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@clearpulsehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearpulsehealth.com>, Chris Wang <chris.wang@clearpulsehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security exhibit / pen-test window — kickoff and evidence cadence

Karthik —

Thanks for the call this morning. We got initial sign-off from our procurement lead to move forward, but legal needs a compact path on the security exhibit and audit rights before we finalize the Order Form. High-level asks from their side:

- Confirmation of SOC 2 Type 2 reporting cadence and sample set availability.
- Pen-test notice window (they prefer 30 days) and staging access approach.
- How Redwood handles evidence requests (S3 links vs packaged PDFs) and expected SLAs for responses.
- A clear fallback if Redwood cannot grant staging access (snapshot/forensic report or scoped remote testing).

Can you share a short proposal (1–2 pages) that we can attach to the Order Form? Also attaching our procurement timeline: they need legal-ready language by 11/20 to hit the board review.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick sync if helpful.

—Natalie
Natalie Ruiz
Director, IT Procurement
ClearPulse Health

Attachment: procurement_timeline_CPH.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Ruiz <natalie@clearpulsehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / pen-test window — kickoff and evidence cadence

Natalie —

Appreciate the clarity and the deadline. Looping in Laura (legal) and Ben (sales ops) so we can put together a concise handoff doc that maps to your procurement asks. Initial notes from our side:

- SOC 2: we produce an annual SOC 2 Type 2 report and can provide the most recent copy (Q3 2028). For recurring evidence, we offer a quarterly evidence bundle (pdfs + access logs) and an on-demand sample export within 5 business days for scoped items.
- Pen test: standard notice is 21 days but we can accommodate 30 days for enterprise agreements if we set a staging-access plan and limited blast radius.
- Evidence delivery: prefer secure S3 links (time-limited) plus packaged PDFs for legal. We can redact customer PII on request. SLA: initial evidence handoff within 5 business days, follow-ups within 3.
- Fallbacks: offer (a) scoped remote testing results, (b) a signed attestation from our security team with sanitized logs, or (c) an on-premise inspection option for Private deployments.

Action items I propose: Laura to provide redline language for the security exhibit and pen-test clause by EOD 11/16; Ben to confirm commercial acceptability of 30-day notice and any credit/ops carveouts; I will draft the 1–2 page handoff (attachment + bulleted cadence) and send back to you by 11/17.

If procurement prefers a short call, we can set 30 minutes tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks —
Karthik
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / pen-test window — kickoff and evidence cadence

Team —

I reviewed Natalie's asks and sketched redline guidance for the security exhibit and MSA/Order Form. Key negotiation levers and suggested language (high-level):

1) SOC 2: confirm delivery of the latest SOC 2 Type 2 report and define "evidence" as company-produced compliance artifacts (reports, configuration snapshots, and sanitized logs). Add statement that SOC 2 report may be provided under NDA; do not concede to perpetual access to production systems.

2) Pen-test notice and staging: accept 30-day notice for enterprise Order Form only with two conditions — (i) scope limited to non-production/staging environment unless customer is on Redwood Private, (ii) customer-required tools must be pre-approved and run under Redwood supervision or within a controlled test harness. Proposed clause: "Customer will provide 30 days' notice. Redwood will designate test windows and accept third-party testers on an approved-tools basis. Production systems are excluded unless Customer has Redwood Private and executes an additional inspection agreement."

3) Evidence cadence and SLAs: offer a 5-business-day initial evidence handoff, but cap evidence requests to 6 unique requests per 12-month period for performance reasons; further requests require mutual agreement and may be charged. This protects ops load.

4) Redlines: add a clause for "Fallbacks" offering (a) an attestation and summary of test results, (b) a sanitized log bundle, or (c) a remote observation session led by Redwood security. Include indemnity carveouts are business-critical — avoid open-ended indemnities tied to uptime.

I've prepared an attachment with the redlined exhibit and the fallback matrix (see pen_test_scope_draft.docx, orderform_v1_redlines.docx). If Ben confirms commercial framing for caps/charges, I will finalize a short exhibit to attach.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Nov 2028 15:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security exhibit / pen-test window — kickoff and evidence cadence

Natalie —

Thanks for the patience. Per Laura and Ben we've attached a concise handoff and proposed exhibit redlines that match your procurement timeline. Summary of what we're proposing for attachment to the Order Form:

- SOC 2: attach SOC2_Type2_2028.pdf under NDA; quarterly evidence bundles and on-demand sample exports with 5 business day SLA.
- Pen test: enterprise Order Form will include 30-day notice; scope confined to staging unless Private deployment; tools must be pre-approved.
- Evidence cadence: up to 6 scoped evidence requests per 12-month period included; additional requests handled via statement-of-work at our published rate. Initial evidence handoff within 5 business days.
- Fallbacks: attestation + sanitized logs or remote observation session.

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_2028.pdf (pdf), pen_test_scope_draft.docx (docx), orderform_v1_redlines.docx (docx)

Next steps for you: please confirm by EOD 11/20 if this aligns with procurement/legal expectations and whether procurement wants Redwood to provide a short 30-minute walkthrough of the exhibit for their legal counsel (we can do 11/21 or 11/22). Once we have confirmation, Ben will finalize pricing caveats tied to evidence caps and I will circulate a DocuSign-ready Order Form (link below).

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Redwood/CPH_MSA_001
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/contacts/CPH-4012

Best,
